general_theorem.definition: For target/source formulas over a common variable universe, phi(v)=v outside a support S of size at most fixed K; for v in S, phi(v) may be any signed source literal and repetitions are allowed.
general_theorem.candidate_upper_bound: sum_{s=0}^K binom(n,s) (2n)^s = O(n^(2K)) for every fixed constant K.
general_theorem.verification: Each candidate is checked using the polynomial R44BS clause-image condition: every target clause maps to a tautology or contains a source clause.
general_theorem.conclusion: For every fixed K, deterministic exhaustive discovery over this class is polynomial time in the encoded sibling size.

K4_instance.effect: The K=4 deterministic search contains this certificate and therefore discovers a valid B->A safe deletion without unbounded substitution search.
K4_instance.rank_effect: R44BR critical parent maxdef 2 -> retained A maxdef 0

infinite_disjoint_lift.construction: Take t variable-disjoint renamed copies of the R44BR critical parent and branch only on the pivot of the distinguished first copy. Other copies are unchanged and common to both siblings.
infinite_disjoint_lift.rank_accounting: Parent maxdef is 2t by additivity. The x2=false sibling has maxdef 2t-2 and the x2=true sibling has maxdef 2t-1.
infinite_disjoint_lift.transport: Apply the same support-4 R44BS substitution on the distinguished copy and identity on every variable of every untouched common copy.
infinite_disjoint_lift.discovery: The global substitution still has deviation support exactly 4, so fixed-K=4 discovery finds a valid safe deletion for every t.
infinite_disjoint_lift.meaning: There is an arbitrarily large exact critical-derived family with deterministic polynomial substitution discovery and destructive rank descent.

next_exact_question: Does any universal constant K suffice for K-deviation substitution transports on all maxdef-critical siblings? The shared-pivot critical family from the parallel R44BR support theorem is the immediate obstruction candidate.
